name: ai-prompt-redaction
description: Scans messages on claude.ai and redacts secrets and sensitive data before they are sent.

scripts.test: node test/detectors.test.js && node test/interceptor.test.js && node test/indicator.test.js
scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chromium
scripts.build:chromium: node scripts/stage-chromium.js && web-ext build --source-dir build/chromium --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename "{name}-{version}-chromium.zip"
